result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is a clear typo in the search placeholder and a few edge-truncation issues on carousels that make content appear clipped rather than intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped at the screen edge with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Truncate the name with an ellipsis within the card width, or add right padding/peek spacing so partial cards clearly indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: A category chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge showing only a thin sliver, which looks like a rendering glitch rather than an affordance for more chips.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so a larger, recognizable portion of the next chip peeks into view, or add a fade/gradient edge to signal horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The delivery fee text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') and meta info under restaurant names is rendered in light gray, giving low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for small text).
